sql.propToolUtility.getAllForCompany: select u.id, u.utility_company, u.company_id, u.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(utilityStates))) FROM ( SELECT ust.id, ust.utility_id as "utilityId" FROM props.utility_state ust WHERE ust.utility_id = u.id and ust.archived is not true) utilityStates), '[]') AS "utilityStates" from props.utility u where u.company_id = :companyId and u.archived is not true order by u.utility_company
sql.propToolUtility.update: update props.utility set utility_company = :utilityCompany where id = :id
sql.propToolUtility.delete: update props.utility set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
